ev.q: the prevalence of periodontitis decreased substantially for all adults regardless of smoking status
Approximately 19% of current smokers had periodontitis during 1988--1994, compared with 4% of nonsmokers.
the overall prevalence of moderate and severe periodontitis declined substantially among adults aged 20--64 years
current smokers continued to be nearly five times as likely to have periodontitis compared with nonsmokers
National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, United States, 1988--1994 and 1999--2004

methods_quotes.q: Based on the CDC and American Academy of Periodontology definition of moderate and severe periodontitis.
